remarks: Tucked behind a tall fence flanked by stone pillars, this customized contemporary home feels like a private hideaway, but less than 5 minutes to town, schools, beach and train. Looking for one level living? That can be easily accommodated here with a sun-filled main level open floor plan featuring a Living Room with fireplace, a large well-equipped Kitchen with a spacious Dining Area and Breakfast Bar, and a Family Room with walls of windows inviting nature in. There is also a private office next to the first floor Primary Bedroom with a full Bath. Several french doors are strategically placed to access the oversized deck that spans the length of the rear of the house, and there is a staircase leading to the picturesque backyard. Upstairs you will find the 2nd Bedroom with vaulted ceiling, skylights and a full Bath which can easily be used as a Studio or Office. The finished walk-out lower level offers the 3rd Bedroom and full Bath plus a large flex space for a Playroom, Recreation Room or whatever suits you. There is a Mudroom that connects the house to the 2 car Garage, and above the Garage is a large unfinished space that is approximately 22X24.  So much to love about this wonderful property.
